text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower takes first place. Mihono 
Bourbon offers her heartfelt praise, and 
the two promise to face each other again 
in the Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, despite missing out on victory, 
Matikanetannhauser remained as positive as 
ever, saying, "There's always next time!" 
despite her lingering frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After returning home, at 
Matikanetannhauser's suggestion, the next 
major goal was set as the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to fit in a long-distance race 
before spring, her next target race was 
set as the Diamond Stakes!
